description: Returns current, sourced and machine-readable evidence supporting or contradicting a prediction-market proposition. Paid per call with x402 on Base: $0.01 to $0.05 USDC depending on how much of the answer the network already has. Shared: reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less, and the wallet that produced it earns a bounded credit.

market.description: Market venue identifier (e.g. polymarket, omen, kalshi). Defaults to polymarket.

marketUrl.description: Optional market URL for resolution rules extraction.

name: prediction_evidence
title: Gather sourced machine-readable evidence supporting or contradicting a prediction market proposition
